name: Masked Entropy Model for TensoRF-VM
definition: A compression method for TensoRF-VM feature planes that uses learnable binary masks to selectively compress only high-importance grid locations, addressing the inefficiency of standard entropy models on sparse, zero-heavy latent codes.
summary: Masked Entropy Model for TensoRF-VM compresses feature planes by using learnable binary masks to selectively encode only high-importance grid locations, achieving smaller file sizes than standard entropy models.
